name: @sheafhq/anchor-signet
description: Anchor a Signet audit log head to Sheaf — one command, no changes to your Signet setup. Takes a Signet records.jsonl, computes the current head hash + count, submits as a Sheaf event, prints the verification URL. Pair with cron or systemd for periodic anchoring. Signet (Apache-2.0 / MIT) is a standalone attestation layer by prismer-ai; this adapter is maintained independently and does not modify Signet state.
